versions.research_rationale: EO 11409 has five operative items. In level IV of EO 11248 it (1a) replaces item (3), the Food-for-Peace Special Assistant, with the Administrator, SRS; (1b) replaces item (4), the crime commission's Executive Secretary, with the Administrator, NIH; and (1c) adds (8) the Administrator, HSMHA and (9) the Executive Director, Cabinet Committee on Price Stability. In level V it (2) replaces item (15), the Administrator, SRS, with the Deputy Administrator, HSMHA. Items (3), (4), (8) and (15) survived every later amender and ended with EO 11708 sec. 3 on March 23, 1973. EO 11708 sec. 1 places the first three positions anew by its own authority; none is a sec. 2 exception. EO 11468 formally deleted item (9) on May 10, 1969. The committee was an ad hoc body, and no held source shows when it was discontinued, so that clause's first_end stays open. The whole-order end is 1973-03-23 in any case. Family method: the researcher read the saved official Federal Register OCR text layers (heading to FR Doc line) of this order, of EO 11248 and of all 40 orders that the OFR disposition notes and the 1989 Codification list as amending it, plus EO 11708, 11715, 11736 and 11768, and traced every item of EO 11248 sections 1 and 2 through each addition, deletion, word substitution and renumbering. EO 11708 sec. 3 (signed and filed March 23, 1973; no other effective date) revokes EO 11248 as amended, except for the eight positions listed in its section 2; none of them is a position whose placement this order's text still supplied. Where a later amender deletes an item and inserts another in its place, the earlier item's placement ends on that amender's effective date; the series' separate 'substituting for the words' formula is treated as a retitling that continues the item. Pure deletions, renumberings and effective-date provisions are one-time edits completed when the order took effect. The 5 U.S.C. 5315-5316 amendment notes for 1964-1973 record no statutory placement of the positions concerned. Abolition of a position by unpublished departmental action is outside the held sources and is a limitation of this bounded search. Page images were not viewed; quotations are exact from the saved OCR, including its recognition errors. No human certification is asserted.

savings_residuals.reason: The order only placed, removed or renumbered positions in pay levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule under 5 U.S.C. 5317 (formerly sec. 303(f) of the 1964 Salary Reform Act). Removal of a placement operates prospectively; pay already received is a completed historical consequence, and no entitlement, transfer of functions or right is preserved. Neither the acting order nor EO 11708 contains a savings or incumbent-protection clause for this order's items. The only carve-out, EO 11708 sec. 3's exception for the positions listed in its sec. 2, does not cover them; EO 11768's incumbent clause (1974) concerns its own list.

savings_residuals.reason: The order only placed, removed or renumbered positions in pay levels IV and V of the Executive Schedule under 5 U.S.C. 5317 (formerly sec. 303(f) of the 1964 Salary Reform Act). Removal of a placement operates prospectively; pay already received is a completed historical consequence, and no entitlement, transfer of functions or right is preserved. Neither the acting order nor EO 11708 contains a savings or incumbent-protection clause for this order's items. The only carve-out, EO 11708 sec. 3's exception for the positions listed in its sec. 2, does not cover them; EO 11768's incumbent clause (1974) concerns its own list.

unresolved_material_gaps: Clause EO:11409#item1c-level-IV-item9: the date the Cabinet Committee on Price Stability (and its Executive Director position) was discontinued is not in held sources. The clause ended then or, at the latest, on 1969-05-10 (EO 11468 item 1). Needs the committee's establishing and discontinuing documents.
claim.research_rationale: EO 11409 has five operative items. In level IV of EO 11248 it (1a) replaces item (3), the Food-for-Peace Special Assistant, with the Administrator, SRS; (1b) replaces item (4), the crime commission's Executive Secretary, with the Administrator, NIH; and (1c) adds (8) the Administrator, HSMHA and (9) the Executive Director, Cabinet Committee on Price Stability. In level V it (2) replaces item (15), the Administrator, SRS, with the Deputy Administrator, HSMHA. Items (3), (4), (8) and (15) survived every later amender and ended with EO 11708 sec. 3 on March 23, 1973. EO 11708 sec. 1 places the first three positions anew by its own authority; none is a sec. 2 exception. EO 11468 formally deleted item (9) on May 10, 1969. The committee was an ad hoc body, and no held source shows when it was discontinued, so that clause's first_end stays open. The whole-order end is 1973-03-23 in any case. Family method: the researcher read the saved official Federal Register OCR text layers (heading to FR Doc line) of this order, of EO 11248 and of all 40 orders that the OFR disposition notes and the 1989 Codification list as amending it, plus EO 11708, 11715, 11736 and 11768, and traced every item of EO 11248 sections 1 and 2 through each addition, deletion, word substitution and renumbering. EO 11708 sec. 3 (signed and filed March 23, 1973; no other effective date) revokes EO 11248 as amended, except for the eight positions listed in its section 2; none of them is a position whose placement this order's text still supplied. Where a later amender deletes an item and inserts another in its place, the earlier item's placement ends on that amender's effective date; the series' separate 'substituting for the words' formula is treated as a retitling that continues the item. Pure deletions, renumberings and effective-date provisions are one-time edits completed when the order took effect. The 5 U.S.C. 5315-5316 amendment notes for 1964-1973 record no statutory placement of the positions concerned. Abolition of a position by unpublished departmental action is outside the held sources and is a limitation of this bounded search. Page images were not viewed; quotations are exact from the saved OCR, including its recognition errors. No human certification is asserted.
